summary: One of the biggest problems amateur space enthusiasts like my team and I face is the fact that much of space exploration is marginalized. Many space centers around the world promise an educational and fun experience, however only show the rovers and spacecraft of that time. They forget about the many spacecrafts and probes that got us to this position. Personally I believe they are just as important and their story should not be erased. We propose to solve this through Forgotten Flybys, as short animated story made every month or week showcasing the stores of spacecrafts and machinery forgotten across the solar system.
details: Forgotten Flybys addresses the important mission to bring retired spacecraft to their former glory in space centers across the world. Firstly, our video's purpose is to teach space enthusiasts in an animated way about the lost and retired rovers. This can benefit many amateur space enthusiasts around the world by showing them in a short entertaining way what the rovers did. The intended impact of this video is to teach people interested in space, and also provide some space centers a way to teach kids. We used Capcut and Kdenlive to edit, then for animation we chose to use Krita. The websites that helped with SFX and music are pixabay and upbeat; we used docs to plan out our day. Our creativity is expressed through a cinematic story using animation. We considered the entertainment of the kids, and all ages while trying to animate the video as realistically as possible, retaining key locations of deep space radiotowers, satellite orbiters, and the animation style.
